items: If God is good, why is there evil?
The Church says suffering is God’s punishment
Why does a good God allow suffering?
why: What Jesus and the apostles say about the meaning of suffering.
A good and all-powerful God would not allow evil.
If God is good and all-powerful, why is there evil and suffering?
God does not will evil, yet allows it for a greater good.
The Church holds that faith and reason cannot contradict each other, since God is the author of both.
The Church does not explain suffering away, and she does not tell people to be cheerful.
The friends spent the book arguing that Job must have sinned.
